evidence: styles/tokens.css:56 -- --color-amber-600: #b9744a (promised #875720). The ROLE the promise assigns to the token is unchanged; only the value was re-skinned.
decision_ref: R6 'Pure Black' supersedes the R4 Warm Graphite palette: styles/tokens.css:1-26 (R6 header + 'names are historical, not literal'), docs/redesign/R9_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md:79 ('The R6 Pure Black doctrine stands'), docs/redesign/VYSTED_DESIGN.md:8-20 (binding contract: pure-neutral #0a0a0a, peach accent #fab283), DECISIONS.md:45 (D28 pins amber-400=#fab283 as the brand peach).

promise: Per FR-030, the amber/charcoal token values, globals.css's --accent-rgb (and every fallback hex), and chart-theme.ts's ACCENT_CORAL* constants + chart neutrals must all change together in one commit, or the chart canvas visually drifts from the chrome.
evidence: Two of the three lockstep surfaces are on R6: styles/tokens.css:52-56 (amber peach) and src/lib/chart-theme.ts:21-47 (neutral chart palette mirroring charcoal-*, ACCENT_CORAL=#cccccc, with the name-vs-role note at :13-18). src/app/globals.css:55 sets --accent-rgb: 120 120 120 -- deliberately neutral per its own comment :51-54 and docs/redesign/VYSTED_DESIGN.md:350.
gap: 'and every fallback hex' was NOT done: 27 var(--color-*, #hex) fallbacks in src/app/globals.css still carry RETIRED R4 Warm Graphite values (e.g. :201,:208,:222 var(--color-amber-400, #d89a4e); :346 var(--color-charcoal-900, #1a1814); :349 var(--color-lume, #f7f5f0)), plus 17 non-color fallbacks frozen at R4 values (:244,:251 --font-weight-heading, 590 vs token 700; :304 --radius-panel, 0.375rem vs token 0; :255 --text-panel-title, 0.9375rem vs token 0.8125rem). This directly contradicts src/app/globals.css:18-20, which claims 'Fallbacks use NEUTRAL values so a missing token degrades to the same neutral gray -- never warm, never blue'.

promise: Signal colors are unchanged and are the only other saturated colors in the app, reserved for P&L only: positive #3fbf6f, negative #e5544b, warning #e0a13a.
evidence: styles/tokens.css:79-83 (positive #3fbf6f, negative #e5544b, warning #e0a13a) and src/lib/chart-theme.ts:34-38 carry the identical three values -- unchanged across two full reskins.
gap: The 'only other saturated colors' clause now has one recorded exception: the research depth-heat family (styles/tokens.css:90-92, --color-depth-ultra #f08a4b), added deliberately by DECISIONS.md:45 (D28).
decision_ref: DECISIONS.md:45 (D28)

promise: The warning color stays visibly yellower than the brand amber and appears only as a labelled badge (e.g. STALE/PAPER), so it never reads as the accent color.
evidence: Yellower-than-brand holds (#e0a13a vs the peach #fab283, styles/tokens.css:83 vs :54) and the documented meaning is still 'stale data' (src/components/DataBadges.tsx:17).
gap: 'appears only as a labelled badge (STALE/PAPER)' is not true in shipped code: warning is now a general caution tone on unlabelled and unrelated surfaces -- a bare pulsing status dot (src/components/StatusChrome.tsx:208 'bg-warning animate-pulse'), a budget bar fill (src/modules/chat/AgentsRail.tsx:134), a no-data glyph (src/modules/chart/ChartPanel.tsx:1385), plain notice text (src/modules/screener/ScreenerPanel.tsx:241,427), plugin lifecycle states (src/components/PluginManagerPanel.tsx:136,138,256), 'Docker not found' and keybinding conflicts (src/components/SettingsPanel.tsx:744,1466,1482).

promise: The ambient radial-gradient glow behind the body in globals.css is removed entirely -- the canvas renders as a flat warm field with no ambient glow.
evidence: src/app/globals.css:135-144 -- the body rule is 'Flat pure-neutral field. No ambient glow, no grain, no vignette, no gradient' and sets background-image: none. Zero radial-gradient in the file.

promise: The only allowed shadow-like effects are a 1px hard accent border, the inset active-tab tick, and a quiet 1px bezel with no blur.
evidence: 1px hard accent border: src/app/globals.css:201 (.hud-active) and :208 (.node-active), both 'box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px' (zero blur). Inset active-tab tick: :378 'box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0'. The bezel went FURTHER than promised -- src/app/globals.css:58-60 removes the shadow primitive entirely ('No shadow/glow primitive of ANY kind').

promise: No box-shadow/filter/drop-shadow with blur radius greater than 1px is used as a halo or bloom anywhere, no gradient is used as ambient light/fill on chrome/cards/canvas, and nothing is named glow/halo/bloom/neon/ambient.
evidence: grep over src/ (*.tsx,*.ts,*.css): zero matches for shadow-(md|lg|xl|2xl), drop-shadow, blur-. Every box-shadow in src/app/globals.css (:201,:208,:378) has a 0px blur radius; :500,:517 set --xy-controls-box-shadow/box-shadow to none. The only gradients (:398-399) are mask-image fades. The retired '.node-glow' name is gone (:205-206 records the replacement).
gap: Residual name-level noise only, in comments/domain words: src/app/globals.css:206 names the retired .node-glow, and 'ambient' survives as a DOMAIN word (src/store/chat-history.ts:6, src/store/research-spaces.ts:194 'ambient copilot turns'), never as a visual effect.

promise: Text hierarchy is expressed only via weight, opacity, and spacing -- never via color -- and the UI shows three visibly distinct text tiers.
evidence: Three distinct tiers DO exist and are used at scale: charcoal-100 primary (261 call sites), charcoal-400 secondary (239), charcoal-500 tertiary (199) across src/+plugins/; styles/tokens.css:41-45 assigns the roles.
gap: The 'NEVER via color' clause was deliberately reversed: docs/redesign/R9_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md:44+ (sec2, D27) makes hierarchy below 16px 'weight (400/500/700) + color, never size'. The PDD contradicts itself on this point -- its own sec4 table (PRODUCT_DESIGN_DECISIONS.md:117-121) defines the three tiers BY color token.
decision_ref: DECISIONS.md:44 (D27); docs/redesign/R9_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md:44+

promise: The primary text tier is charcoal-100 (#f5f2ec) at weight 400-510, used for content such as brief prose, answers, prices, and headings.
evidence: Role delivered: styles/tokens.css:45 charcoal-100 is 'PRIMARY text / foreground', 261 call sites. Values dropped: the hex is #ededed (not #f5f2ec) and the weights are 400/500/700 (styles/tokens.css:122-124), not 400-510.

promise: The secondary text tier is charcoal-300/400 at weight 400, used for supporting labels, table secondaries, and descriptions.
